hooks.command: git fetch origin --quiet 2>/dev/null; n=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main 2>/dev/null); if [ "${n:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then echo "WARNING: the current branch is $n commit(s) behind origin/main. Rebase onto origin/main before starting work, or the PR will conflict (Dependabot merges often)."; fi

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */src/*.ts|*/src/*.tsx) node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$f" --config ./prettier.config.cjs ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
